RELEVANT CHARACTER BACKGROUND
Ingrid Lindgren is a woman in her mid-thirties who owns and manages a hotel in Gamla Stan, overseeing housekeeping, front desk operations, staff training, guest feedback tracking, and contractor coordination. A practical, business-minded standard from her grandfather emphasizes preventing small problems from becoming larger ones. She also has an inherited sense of taste that appears in her preference for understated, high-quality clothing and presentation. She grew up outside Uppsala in a family of teachers and a librarian: her father was a high school teacher and her mother a librarian. She has no siblings.

She has arranged the hotel’s ground-floor linen closet as a small bedroom with a courtyard view so her mother can wander safely during the day while Ingrid works. Ingrid usually takes about ten minutes alone with a cup of tea before the front desk opens at 8:00 AM. This morning she realizes she forgot to order refills for the third-floor bathroom hand soap. The supplier closes at noon. Ingrid can use her tea break to place the order now, or wait until later in the day and risk a guest complaint.
